name: sendwise-campus-extension
description: SendWise Campus - MV3 browser extension (academic prototype).

scripts.sync-vendor: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.rmSync('vendor',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('vendor/detection-library',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync('vendor/models',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../shared/detection-library'))fs.copyFileSync(p.join('../shared/detection-library',f),p.join('vendor/detection-library',f));for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../shared/models'))fs.copyFileSync(p.join('../shared/models',f),p.join('vendor/models',f));console.log('vendor synced');"
scripts.build: npm run sync-vendor && npm run prebuild && cd .. && zip -r extension/dist/sendwise-campus-extension.zip extension -x 'extension/dist/*' 'extension/node_modules/*' 'extension/package*.json'
